query:
UPDATE images SET
                    perceptual_hash = ?,
                    perceptual_hash_center = ?,
                    perceptual_hash_tl = ?,
                    perceptual_hash_tr = ?,
                    perceptual_hash_bl = ?,
                    perceptual_hash_br = ?,
                    perceptual_hash_256 = ?,
                    color_histogram = ?
                WHERE id = (
                    SELECT image_id FROM media_images WHERE media_id = ?
                )
